meta.title: Balamentum – What should you work on next?
meta.description: Balamentum uses your task dependencies and life areas to work out which task matters most right now. Sign in with Google and get going.

hero.title: What should you work on next?
hero.lead: Balamentum answers exactly that. It weighs dependencies and your life areas to find the task that pays off most right now. You get things done instead of sorting lists.
hero.ctaNote: Free, no credit card. Email sign-in links work for existing accounts.
hero.screenshotAlt: Balamentum dashboard showing the next task and the life balance

usp.title: What you get
items: Less second-guessing: the app tells you what matters now.
More balance: no area of your life gets left behind for long.
Quick capture: type or speak your tasks.
Start for free, no credit card.

items.title: Sign in with Google
items.text: One click. No form, no password.

items.title: Add your tasks
items.text: Type or speak them. Link dependencies and life areas whenever you like.

items.title: Do the next task
items.text: The dashboard shows what matters now and how balanced your week is.

items.title: One next task, not an endless list
items.text: The app shows the most valuable task whose prerequisites are already done. That is your answer to “what now?”.
points: Value, priority and effort of every task count.
Tasks still waiting on others stay out of the way.
Tap “Done” and the next one moves up.

items.title: Objective, not guessed
items.text: Body, relationships, meaning, mental health, impact: every single task carries its own weight. Your balance is objective, based on effort-weighted work actually done, not on self-assessment.
points: Five pillars: body, mental health, relationships, impact and meaning.
The chart on the dashboard shows how balanced your last four weeks were.
If you like, the list moves tasks from neglected pillars to the top.

items.title: A real task graph
items.text: Tasks build on each other. Balamentum's graph-based engine adds up value and effort along the whole chain and detects cycles.
points: The graph shows which task waits for which.
Value and effort add up along the whole chain.
The app detects cycles and tells you.

items.title: Plan together
items.text: Invite family or team to a group by link and hand tasks to each other.
points: Invite by link, no address book needed.
Create tasks for each other and hand them over.

items.title: AI and voice input
items.text: Capture tasks by voice. The AI suggests matching pillars and polishes titles and descriptions, with your own provider if you prefer.
points: Speak a whole sentence and the AI turns it into separate tasks.
It suggests matching pillars along the way.
Voice input is already part of the free plan.

items.title: Plan with your AI assistant
items.text: Through the MCP interface your AI assistant can reach your tasks. Ask in the chat what is next, add tasks, or have your balance explained.
points: Create an access token in the settings and add the MCP address to your assistant.
Works with Claude and other assistants that speak MCP over HTTP.
Reading comes with Max, creating and editing with Ultimate.

items.title: Open and always at hand
items.text: Installable on phone and desktop, with push reminders and location reminders.
points: Install straight from the browser, no app store.

chat.label: Example: chatting with an AI assistant over MCP
chat.caption: Example chat

messages.text: Next up is “Book a yoga class”, priority 4. It is due the day after tomorrow.
Done. “Visit grandma” is on your list, due Saturday.
92 %, you are in balance. All five pillars are on target.

pricing.title: Plans
pricing.lead: Start for free. Need more? Switch plans in the app at any time.
pricing.discounts: Pay quarterly and save 10 %, pay yearly and save 20 %. All prices are final; no VAT is charged under § 19 UStG (German small business rule).
pricing.basics: Tasks, series, checklists, deadlines, points and balance analysis

features.ai_assist: AI help: pillar advisor and copy editing

items.a: The Free plan costs nothing and has no limit on the number of tasks. Pro, Max and Ultimate unlock groups, AI help and interfaces.

items.q: What data does the app get from Google?
items.a: Only your name, email address and profile picture. You don't need a separate password.

items.q: How do I cancel a plan?
items.a: In the app under Settings. Billing runs through PayPal, and you can switch or cancel at any time.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Balamentum is built for one-handed use and can be installed as an app on your home screen.
The interface follows WCAG 2.2 and BITV 2.0 and is built on the tested KoliBri components.

final.title: Your next task is waiting
final.text: Sign in, add your first task, get going.

accountDeletion.title: Delete your account
accountDeletion.intro: How to delete your Balamentum account and its data.
steps: In the “Konto” (Account) card, tap “Delete account” and confirm both steps.
accountDeletion.blocked: If a subscription is still running, cancel it first in the “Abo” (Subscription) tab. If you are the last admin of a group with other members, first make someone else an admin or dissolve the group.
accountDeletion.deleted: Your account with all tasks, series, pillars, categories, settings, access tokens and push registrations. Groups in which you are the only member are deleted as well. Tasks you created for others in groups stay with the recipients, without you as the creator.
accountDeletion.kept: We keep invoices and subscription records for the statutory retention period and delete them afterwards.
accountDeletion.noAccess: Write to us from the email address of your account. We delete the account within one month and confirm it to you.
